speaker: john_heminges
text: On at two. The doors are the doors we set this morning. I am not opening a new matter.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then let us be on, and let us be off. I have no line to add, and I am not inventing one in the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am on. There is nothing of the morning in this afternoon.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Play what is set down. Come off when it is done.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You hear him, Will. Set down. I am capable of set down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are capable together. God give you the house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And you. No figure until Saturday, and no figure promised.
